name: Zenith Mandalic Stab
name_jp: 究極マンダリクスタッブ
effects:
7 single-target Water/NE physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, ATK/MND +25% & DEF/RES +30% to party, Lv.3 En-Water, En-Water Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Water Damage +20%, Physical Casting Speed x1.1 & chases a Water ability with Quick/Instant ATB 2 and Quick/Instant Water 2 to user if user has Fate Synergy (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Water, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Powder Keg+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses; Utsusemi+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
